meta.title: PR Sync Modes (Real-time / Batch): refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify that PR Sync Modes is refused or absent.
Sign in as a Tenant Admin on the same tenant and verify that PR Sync Modes is available for Real-time and scheduled Batch configuration.
Compare the two role outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration.
